headline: Public hearing on a waiver for pipe cover at 23 Wilson Road; site plan for 60 residential units at 196 and 198 Rockingham Road.
summary: A site plan for 60 residential units and a permit for 597 square feet of wetland buffer impact are back on the agenda after earlier continuances. A public hearing on a waiver request at 23 Wilson Road is also scheduled.
items: Formal application for a site plan for 60 residential units and related site improvements, with a conditional use permit for 597 square feet of wetland buffer impact, at 196 and 198 Rockingham Road (continued from earlier meetings)
Public hearing on a waiver from Subdivision Regulations Section 3.08 G.3 to allow less than 3 feet of cover from the top of pipe to finish grade at 23 Wilson Road
